about.free: Play the computer, play a friend online or on one device, and learn the rules with lessons.
about.whatBody: Janggi is the traditional chess of Korea. The pieces stand on the points of a nine by ten board with no river. Before play each side chooses how to set out its Horses and Elephants. Cannons must jump exactly one piece to move or capture and can never jump or take another Cannon. Inside the palace, Chariots, Cannons and Soldiers may follow the diagonal lines. A player may pass. Facing Generals (bikjang), two passes in a row, a threefold repetition or fifty moves without a capture are settled on points, where Han gets 1.5 for moving second. Giving check without end loses.
